original_target.title: Sard conjecture for smooth bracket-generating distributions

scope_comparison: The announced smooth rank-two bracket-generating distribution on R4 has abnormal endpoints equal to R4 from one basepoint; a global frame gives the same L2 control endpoint map. Constant distribution rank is maintained; the local target does not require equiregularity or analyticity. Full endpoint set is not volume-null. Minimizing Sard property is different and is not claimed refuted.
